_doc: The paper's one table and the numbers printed on its bar charts, transcribed at the printed precision. Table 1 from https://arxiv.org/html/2309.06180v1#S5.T1; the bar labels from the figures' SVGs as rendered (Figure 2 S1.F2, Figure 13 S5.F13, Figure 15 S6.F15, Figure 11 legends S5.F11). Line charts are not transcribed here: their points come from the vector paths (inputs/figs.json).

fig2.note: Average percentage of KV cache memory by use during the §6.2 experiment; vLLM's three small segments carry no printed label.

fig13.note: Average number of batched requests, OPT-13B; ShareGPT at 2 requests/s, Alpaca at 30 requests/s.

fig15.note: Memory saving from sharing KV blocks, OPT-13B, Alpaca trace.
